scope: Actual browser File/DataTransfer drops and real folder input: CSV+image one human transaction, IndexedDB reopen/undo, text-list whitespace, ordered images, metadata-filtered folder, invalid-batch no mutation, cancellation and stale prepared import invalidation
accessibility:
- region "Repeat Grid data":
  - heading "Repeat Grid" [level=3]
  - paragraph: 2 cells · row-major order, left to right then down
  - text: Rows
  - spinbutton "Grid rows": "1"
  - text: Columns
  - spinbutton "Grid columns": "2"
  - button "Resize grid"
  - paragraph: Use the green Canvas controls to repeat columns/rows or adjust gutters. Their arrow keys and Home/End provide keyboard alternatives.
  - button "Edit template"
  - paragraph: Resizing keeps surviving cell IDs and data. New cells use the template; shrinking removes the last cells. Maximum 100 cells.
  - region "Drop Repeat Grid files":
    - paragraph: Drop CSV, JSON, a text list, local images or an image folder here.
    - paragraph: Choose files below for the same workflow. Review field mappings and preview before applying. Images use filename order, then cells left to right and down.
  - text: Choose image folder
  - button "Grid image folder"
  - text: Data format
  - combobox "Grid data format":
    - option "CSV"
    - option "JSON" [selected]
  - text: CSV, JSON or text file
  - button "Grid data file"
  - text: Named grid data
  - textbox "Named grid data":
    - /placeholder: "title,photo\nFirst,first.png"
    - text: "[{\"title\":\"First\"},{\"title\":\"Second\"}]"
  - button "Read fields"
  - heading "Field mapping" [level=4]
  - text: Title · text
  - combobox "Map Title text":
    - option "Do not import"
    - option "title" [selected]
  - text: Photo · asset
  - combobox "Map Photo asset":
    - option "Do not import"
    - option "title"
  - text: Email · initialValue
  - combobox "Map Email initialValue":
    - option "Do not import"
    - option "title"
  - text: Email placeholder · text
  - combobox "Map Email placeholder text":
    - option "Do not import"
    - option "title"
  - text: Local images
  - button "Grid local images"
  - paragraph: Image fields name an exact chosen file, such as first.png. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 5 MB each and 8 MB shared per document. Paths and URLs are rejected.
  - text: Missing or empty values
  - combobox "Grid missing values":
    - option "Keep current value" [selected]
    - option "Clear mapped value"
    - option "Reject import"
  - checkbox "Allow truncation of rows beyond the grid"
  - text: Allow truncation of rows beyond the grid
  - paragraph: 2 data rows · 2 cells to update · 0 rows beyond capacity
  - paragraph: Only mapped fields change. Unmapped fields and cells after the final row remain unchanged. Empty CSV cells, absent JSON fields and empty strings use the missing-value rule. JSON values must be strings.
  - button "Preview import"
  - button "Cancel import"
  - status: Import validated · 2 cells · one undoable batch
  - table "Grid mapping preview":
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Cell title → Title":
        - columnheader "Cell"
        - columnheader "title → Title"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "1 First":
        - cell "1"
        - cell "First"
      - row "2 Second":
        - cell "2"
        - cell "Second"
  - paragraph: Showing the first 2 rows. 0 source fields are not mapped.
  - button "Apply grid data"
